name: Inverse Rendering with Neural Radiosity
definition: Optimizing scene parameters p using an objective function z(.) representing the distance between a candidate image and a reference. The gradient ∂z/∂p is computed using a differential radiance network ∂p Lθ.
summary: Inverse Rendering with Neural Radiosity optimizes scene parameters by using neural networks to cache the differential radiance field, amortizing global light transport costs and avoiding independent simulations per optimization step.
